description: Writes an alignment (gapped rows) in an EMBOSS 6.6.0 -aformat output format, byte for byte as the installed programs print it: PAIRWISE formats (exactly two rows; header with program, run date, command line, matrix, gap penalties and Length / Identity / Similarity / Gaps / Score): pair, simple, srspair, srs, markx0, markx1, markx2, markx3, markx10, match, score, sam, tcoffee, unknown, multiple; unknown, multiple, simple, srs and tcoffee also take THREE OR MORE rows (the consensus of EMBOSS alignConsStats under the rows, as aligncopy writes them; the tcoffee library lists every pair of rows; 1 040 / 1 040 committed alignments of 3 - 8 rows equal the installed program), while the pair-markup formats refuse more than two rows with the program's message (Alignment format pair specifies at most 2 sequences, alignment has 3); SEQUENCE-SET formats (any number of rows): fasta, a2m, msf, clustal, mega, meganon, nexus, paup, nexusnon, paupnon, phylip, phylipnon, selex, treecon. The pair formats take the score, the matrix (decides the similarity marks and count), the gap penalties and the program name (needle, water, stretcher, matcher, supermatcher: stretcher prints integer scores). VERIFICATION: 3 303 needle / water / stretcher files (29 formats x 114 alignment sets, faked run dates) and 1 309 seqret files (11 sequence-set formats, 1–9 rows) are identical to the installed EMBOSS 6.6.0. Offsets (residues of the original sequences outside the aligned part) are given per row for the local alignments.

alignedSequences.description: The aligned rows ('-' = gap); two for the pairwise formats, one or more for the sequence-set formats.

format.description: The EMBOSS -aformat name: pair, simple, srspair, srs, markx0, markx1, markx2, markx3, markx10, match, score, sam, tcoffee, unknown, multiple, fasta, a2m, msf, clustal, mega, meganon, nexus, paup, nexusnon, paupnon, phylip, phylipnon, selex, treecon.

names.description: Sequence names (the first word of the FASTA header); default seq1, seq2, ...

descriptions.description: Optional descriptions (one per row; shown by the FASTA writer and with showDescription).

offsets.description: Residues of each original sequence before the aligned part (water: the local start - 1); default 0.

offends.description: Residues of each original sequence after the aligned part; default 0.

matrix.description: Substitution matrix deciding the Similarity count and the marks (EMBOSS name or NCBI name). Omit: EDNAFULL for nucleotide rows, EBLOSUM62 otherwise.

gapOpen.description: Gap open penalty printed in the header (Gap_penalty); omit for no line.

gapExtend.description: Gap extension penalty printed in the header (Extend_penalty); omit for no line.

program.description: The program that produced the alignment: needle, water, stretcher, matcher, supermatcher (header, SAM @PG; stretcher = integer scores, -aglobal Y; water = -aglobal N).

commandLine.description: The command line words printed in the header, one per line (e.g. '-asequence a.fa').

showDescription.description: -adesshow: print the description in the header.

dialect.description: 'emboss' (default): the EMBOSS 6.6 writers named above. 'biopython': the Biopython 1.88 Bio.Align writers fasta, a2m, clustal, phylip, nexus, stockholm (byte for byte as Bio.Align.write; the descriptions are written, the Clustal header says Biopython 1.88).

errors.message: alignedSequences is null or empty, a pairwise format without exactly two rows
unknown format, matrix or malformed runDate
